_meta.note: Who made each model, under what license, and what its authors ask to be cited. Every entry was checked against the project's own README, LICENSE or documentation on 2026-09-06, and every PMID was resolved through PubMed from the DOI the authors publish. Task-level facts (a bundle's authors, a per-model license) live in the catalog manifests and are merged in by haversack.attribution; this file holds what is true of a whole ecosystem or engine. The `tasks` section overrides a single task whose model comes from somewhere other than its catalog. The `encoders` section holds an embedding-field encoder that is no segmentation ecosystem (haversack encode); an nnU-Net encoder is its task's ecosystem.
